HOW IT WORKS

From first message
to problem solved.

Simple communication, clear next steps and service that works around the job—not around a shop counter.

01

Tell us the problem

Call, WhatsApp or send an enquiry with your device issue or project requirement.

02

We visit & diagnose

We come to your home or workplace by appointment and assess what the job needs.

03

Fix on-site when possible

04

Pickup when required

For workshop-level work, we arrange pickup and return after the repair is completed.
